tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce & B2B E-Commerce Technical Solutions Developer | Java, Spring & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Experienced in CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, production troubleshooting, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator and B2B Solution Architect

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2B Commerce Technical Architect
cover_en.hook: Next Engineering's commitment to building the future through robust enterprise innovation strongly aligns with my technical background. Over the past 5+ years building and scaling enterprise B2B and B2C e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have focused on robust architecture, complex integrations, and high-performance delivery.

bullets.label: B2B Commerce & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and B2B customer data management.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations & APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for storefront and third-party consumers, and built data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize global commerce environments.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps Standards
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, maintaining strict development and release standards.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Stakeholders
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role analyzing requirements with business stakeholders, performing code reviews, supporting production stabilizations, and providing technical guidance to developers.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start date: 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my enterprise architecture and integration experience can support Next Engineering.

tailoring.why_company: Next Engineering's dedication to pushing boundaries and building future-proof enterprise solutions deeply resonates with my professional journey. Having spent over five years architecting and scaling complex e-commerce platforms and integrations for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my expertise in B2B commerce architecture, integrations, and technical delivery to support Next Engineering's technology roadmap.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture and integration experience to design scalable B2B commerce solutions and drive technical excellence at Next Engineering.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of experience building and integrating enterprise B2B commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Salesforce B2B Commerce Technical Architect role at Next Engineering. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application - Salesforce B2B Commerce Technical Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce B2B Commerce Technical Architect position at Next Engineering. With over five years of experience architecting enterprise e-commerce solutions, building scalable API integrations, and aligning technical delivery with business objectives at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to add value to your team.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
